rows.grounds: adjective describing the goddess as belonging to a noble or exalted lineage
compound of kaulika (Kaula practitioner) and ārādhyā (worthy of worship)
compound of kaulika (Kaula practitioner), priya (dear), and kāriṇī (doer)

items.question: What lineage and devotional relationship define the goddess in relation to Kaula practitioners?
premises: The goddess is of noble lineage.
The goddess is worshipped by Kaula practitioners.
The goddess performs actions dear to Kaula practitioners.
items.inference: The goddess belongs to an exalted lineage and stands in a reciprocal relationship of worship and benevolence with Kaula practitioners.
items.plain_english: She is of noble lineage, worshipped by Kaula practitioners, and acts in ways that are dear to them.
